en: The front of the postcard is a collage of four color photographs, showing a modernist building with several floors, outdoor seating areas with umbrellas overlooking the sea, lush landscaping, a stylish retro bar with red chairs, and a lobby with a staircase and plants. The back of the postcard contains multilingual text in Bulgarian, Russian, French, and German describing the place, as well as postal information and a blue stamp from the Varna Public Library.
